item.title: xeus-lua to pegasus
item.description: You can send a lua code from jupyter notebook to Solar2D simulator. http post from jupyter lua kernal to lua http-server running on the simulator. xeus-lua - Jupyter kernel for Lua https://github.com/jupyter-xeus/xeus-lua http_print is added to xinterpreter.cpp bool http_print = config_table["http_print"]; bool need_eval = true; if(http_print){ std::stringstream test_code; test_code << "hprint([[" << code << "]])"; auto test_code_result = lua.safe_script(test_code.str(), &sol::script_pass_on_error); need_eval = !test_code_result.valid(); }else if(auto_print){ ... xextend.cpp void add_ilua_module(sol::state_view & lua){ std::string script = R""""( ilua = { display = { _version = "0.1.0" , detail = {} }, widgets = { detail = {} }, canvas = { color = {}, detail = {} }, config = { printer = "pprint", auto_print = true, http_print = false, }, hprint() in ilua runtime receives the code text from a jupyter notebook.
